stops.title: Hwan na ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu
stops.caption: Ɛboro sɛ wobɛba kɛkɛ.
stops.speech: Nkitahodie kan nneɛma pii sene mmaeɛ: sɛ obi wɔ kuo mu, ɔsom wɔ kuo bi mu, na yɛredi n’akyi.

stops.title: Nkitahodie nhwɛbea
stops.caption: Baabi a nnipa gyae.
stops.speech: Nkyekyɛmu no kyerɛ baabi a nnipa twe wɔn ho, na ɛtaa ba ansa na wɔagyae ba, ɛnyɛ akyire.
